scope: Logic-only audit of IDEA000027, IDEA000028, IDEA000029; no manuscript result or semantic truth inferred.
predecessors: IDEA000015 was checked through its current idea card and the targeted IDEA000015 implication audit; GDT238 was checked as the named modal-route predecessor. GDT238 explicitly limits its prefix result to a weak visible relation/rendering mode and no portable relation/object key.

reviews.title: A whole-word candidate binds one botanical part class
reviews.binding: The proposal binds complete candidate wholes to independently indexed botanical-part observations on separate folios, with section/page matched controls.
countermodels: A generic material or botanical-register lexeme can co-occur with one frequently drawn part without denoting that part.
A botanical lexeme can be mentioned when the relevant part is not drawn; absence of a part observation is then missing opportunity, not a negative semantic instance.
A true broad material meaning can have diffuse multi-part distribution, so failure of one-part concentration rejects the narrow part-binding claim only.
reviews.required_correction: Model part visibility/opportunity and distinguish part naming from botanical-section membership. A positive concentration is evidence for bounded part association, not by itself proof that the whole lexically denotes the part.

reviews.title: Modal obligation is distinct from descriptive action
reviews.binding: The proposal compares candidate-bearing and candidate-free action contexts using independently coded procedural context and matched descriptive fields.
countermodels: A plain action lexeme can occur inside required, forbidden, conditional, or descriptive frames; lexical action meaning does not entail absence of modality.
A modal operator can be a separate neighboring construction, so candidate-bearing fields can show a modal shift without the candidate itself encoding obligation.
Independent medieval-style annotation can introduce annotator wording or genre bias; the proposal acknowledges this only in its falsifier.
reviews.required_correction: Treat the test as operator-scope discrimination conditional on independently fixed action and modal annotations. A null contrast weakens this candidate-as-modal-operator mechanism, not all action or modality readings.

reviews.title: Record genre changes field-role distribution
reviews.binding: The proposal uses complete candidate occurrences in independently classified description/instruction records, stratified by genre and controlled for register and position.
countermodels: One portable lexical meaning can take different field roles or pragmatic frames in description versus instruction genres.
Genre, register, position, or record schema can create a role interaction without a lexical semantic shift.
No interaction can reflect low power or broad role flexibility; it does not falsify portability by itself.
reviews.required_correction: Separate portable lexical core from genre-conditioned compound/field role. A genre interaction is evidence for role-frame modulation only after independent genre labels and record controls; it is not evidence that the whole changes meaning.

overall: All three designs need narrower claim ceilings. Broad meaning, compound role, and genre/modal context are separate hypotheses. The proposal falsifiers can reject each declared bounded mechanism under adequate independent bindings; they do not entail or refute a universal portable translation.

## Interpretation

The result refines, rather than reverses, GDT235–237.  Some transferred label
prefixes appear to participate in a graphical **relation/rendering mode** that
is more stable than the full family.  The full family still does not carry a
portable relation or object key.  A conservative working decomposition is:

```text
PARTIAL LABEL/RELATION RENDERER + REGISTER-BOUND OPAQUE RESIDUAL
```

“Relation renderer” here means only that a source-family prefix weakly predicts
the catalogue's visible attachment/proximity class.  It does not say the
prefix means “near,” “attached,” “inside,” or any other relation.  Proximity is
not ownership, and the source descriptions are not independent repetitions of
an authorial semantic category.

## Claim ceiling

This is a low-capacity exploratory geometric-association result.  It establishes
no authorial ownership, relation word, object name, morpheme, sound, language,
plaintext, or translation.  No f84 row was retained, joined, or scored, and no
new f84 access occurred.
